title: 🚨 YOUR TALENT ISN’T THE PROBLEM. YOUR STEWARDSHIP IS.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR TALENT ISN’T THE PROBLEM. YOUR STEWARDSHIP IS.
The reason many believers never fulfill their God-given purpose is not because they lack talent...
It's because they keep waiting for a different life, a bigger opportunity, or a more convenient season.
Meanwhile, the gifts God already placed in their hands remain buried.
Most Christians know they have gifts.
Few understand they will one day give an account for how they used them.
Because your talent was never meant merely to make a living.
It was meant to help build God's Kingdom.
"Am I being faithful with what God has already given me?"
Inside this eye-opening book, you'll discover:
✅ How to identify the talents God has placed in your life
✅ Why fear causes believers to bury their gifts
✅ The biblical difference between success and significance
✅ How ordinary skills can create eternal impact
✅ How to stop comparing yourself to others
✅ Practical ways to use your gifts to serve God today
✅ How to build a legacy that outlives you
"Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men."
Few people steward what they already have.
🔥 THIS IS BIGGER THAN A BOOK
This is a movement of believers who refuse to waste their lives.
A movement of Christians committed to:
📚 A growing library of discipleship resources
If you're tired of wasting potential...
If you're ready to stop burying your gifts...
If you're serious about living for eternity...
Join thousands of believers pursuing purpose, discipleship, and Kingdom impact.
